in_marathi.name: Heeransh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Heeransh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Heeransh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Heera' meaning 'Lord' and 'Ansh' meaning 'Manifestation' or 'Presence'. This name is believed to denote the one who is the manifestation of the universe itself. It is a powerful and revered name in Hindu tradition.
